cards.ex: I can whip up some sandwiches if you're hungry.
cards.exUz: Agar och bo'lsangiz, men tezda sendvich tayyorlab beraman.
cards.uzDef: Tezda va osonlik bilan ovqat tayyorlash, odatda shoshilinchda.

cards.ex: She's a real foodie; she knows all the best restaurants.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy ovqatsevar; u barcha eng yaxshi restoranlarni biladi.
cards.uzDef: Ovqatni sevuvchi va ovqat madaniyati bilan qiziqadigan odam.

cards.ex: This recipe is a piece of cake, even I can make it.
cards.exUz: Bu retsept juda oson, hatto men ham qila olaman.
cards.uzDef: Juda oson bo'lgan narsa, qiyinchiliksiz bajariladigan ish.

cards.ex: Let's spice things up and try a new restaurant tonight.
cards.exUz: Keling, vaziyatni qizitib, bugun yangi restoranga boramiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga qiziqarli yoki hayajonli o'zgarishlar kiritish.

cards.ex: We eat out about once a week.
cards.exUz: Biz haftada bir marta tashqarida ovqatlanamiz.
cards.uzDef: Uyda emas, balki restoranda yoki kafeda ovqatlanish.

cards.ex: Let's grab a bite before the movie starts.
cards.exUz: Kino boshlanishidan oldin yengil tamaddi qilib olaylik.
cards.uzDef: Tez va oson ovqatlanish, odatda yengil tamaddi qilish.

cards.ex: Nothing beats a good home-cooked meal.
cards.exUz: Uyda tayyorlangan yaxshi ovqatga hech narsa teng kelmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Uyda tayyorlangan taom, restoranda emas, balki uyda tayyorlangan.

cards.ex: The food's ready, so dig in!
cards.exUz: Ovqat tayyor, shuning uchun osh bo'lsin!
cards.uzDef: Ovqatlanishni boshlash, ishtaha bilan ovqatlanish.

cards.ex: Would you like seconds?
cards.exUz: Sizga qo'shimcha porsiya kerakmi?
cards.uzDef: Taomning yana bir porsiyasi, qo'shimcha ovqat.

cards.ex: We're having a potluck next weekend.
cards.exUz: Biz kelasi hafta oxirida har kimdan ovqat yig'amiz.
cards.uzDef: Har bir ishtirokchi ovqat olib keladigan yig'ilish yoki ziyofat.

cards.ex: Can I get a doggy bag for this?
cards.exUz: Men bu uchun qoldiq ovqat olsam bo'ladimi?
cards.uzDef: Restoranda qolgan ovqatni olib ketish uchun quti.

cards.ex: I spent the whole weekend binge-watching cooking shows.
cards.exUz: Men butun hafta oxirini ovqat ko'rsatuvlarini ketma-ket tomosha qilish bilan o'tkazdim.
cards.uzDef: Televizor ko'rsatuvlarini yoki filmlarni ketma-ket ko'rish.

cards.ex: Let's get takeout tonight, I'm too tired to cook.
cards.exUz: Keling, bugun olib ketishga buyurtma beramiz, men ovqat pishirishga juda charchadim.
cards.uzDef: Restoranda tayyorlangan ovqatni uyga olib ketish.

cards.ex: I'm on a diet, so I can't have dessert.
cards.exUz: Men parhezda bo'lganim uchun desert yeya olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Ozish yoki sog'lom ovqatlanish maqsadida maxsus ovqatlanish rejimida bo'lish.

cards.ex: Mac and cheese is my ultimate comfort food.
cards.exUz: Makaron va pishloq - mening eng sevimli kayfiyat ko'tarar taomim.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi kayfiyat bag'ishlaydigan, odatda sodda va tanish bo'lgan ovqat.

cards.ex: I have a sweet tooth, so I always crave chocolate.
cards.exUz: Menda shirinlikka mehr bor, shuning uchun har doim shokoladga talabim bor.
cards.uzDef: Shirinliklarni sevish, shirinliklarga bo'lgan kuchli ishtiyoq.

cards.ex: I made the cake from scratch.
cards.exUz: Men tortni noldan tayyorladim.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday tayyor ingredientlardan foydalanmasdan, boshidan tayyorlash.

cards.ex: I'm in a food coma after that huge meal.
cards.exUz: O'sha katta ovqatdan keyin men ovqatdan keyingi uyqudaman.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p ovqat yegandan keyin kuchsizlik va uyquga tortish holati.

cards.ex: I accidentally overcooked the chicken.
cards.exUz: Men tasodifan tovuqni pishirib yubordim.
cards.uzDef: Ovqatni juda ko'p pishirish, haddan tashqari pishirish.

cards.ex: The rice was slightly undercooked.
cards.exUz: Guruch biroz yarim pishgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Ovqatni yetarlicha pishirmaslik, xomligicha qoldirish.

cards.ex: Eat up your vegetables!
cards.exUz: Sabzavotlaringizni yeb tugating!
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsani yeb tugatish, hech narsa qoldirmaslik.

cards.ex: The smell of the pizza was mouth-watering.
cards.exUz: Pizza hidi og'izdan suv oqizardi.
cards.uzDef: Juda mazali va ishtahani ochadigan narsa.

cards.ex: Can you set the table, please?
cards.exUz: Iltimos, dasturxon tuzib bera olasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Ovqatlanish uchun stolga idish-tovoq va boshqa narsalarni qo'yish.

cards.ex: I'll clean up after dinner.
cards.exUz: Kechki ovqatdan keyin men yig'ishtiraman.
cards.uzDef: Ovqatdan keyin idish-tovoqlarni yuvish va joyiga qo'yish.

cards.ex: We can have leftovers for lunch tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Ertaga tushlikka qoldiq ovqat yeyishimiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Oldingi ovqatdan qolgan ovqat, keyinroq yeyish uchun saqlab qo'yilgan ovqat.

cards.ex: We're doing a taste test of different brands of coffee.
cards.exUz: Biz turli xil kofe brendlarining ta'mini sinab ko'rmoqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Yangi taom yoki mahsulotning ta'mini sinab ko'rish.

cards.ex: She cooked up a storm for the party.
cards.exUz: U ziyofat uchun juda ko'p va zo'r ovqat tayyorladi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p va ajoyib ovqat tayyorlash.

cards.ex: What's on the menu tonight?
cards.exUz: Bugun menuda nima bor?
cards.uzDef: Menuda mavjud bo'lgan taom yoki ichimlik.

cards.ex: Season to taste with salt and pepper.
cards.exUz: Ta'bingizga ko'ra tuz va murch bilan tuzlang.
cards.uzDef: Ovqatni o'z ta'bingizga mos ravishda tuzlash yoki ziravorlash.

cards.ex: We're having a bake sale to raise money for charity.
cards.exUz: Biz xayriya uchun pul yig'ish uchun pishiriq sotuvini o'tkazmoqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Pishiriqlarni sotish orqali pul yig'ish tadbiri.
